name: Bloodborne bbport Windows
summary: Supermedo's Windows bbport build with your extracted CUSA00900 game and 1.09 update in a portable folder.

release_rules.notes: windows-vN.N releases containing Bloodborne-Windows.zip with a bbport-windows folder.

windows.description: Windows build; files are moved out of its bbport-windows folder.

pkgtool.description: LibOrbisPkg PkgTool 0.2.231 for Linux, used only to extract your PKG files.

inputs.label: Bloodborne (USA) CUSA00900 base game PKG
inputs.notes: Checked after extraction: title CUSA00900, version 01.09 with the update, and an accepted eboot.bin hash.

inputs.label: Previously extracted game folder (optional)
inputs.notes: A folder under the app data prepared/ directory that already contains the extracted game. It is used only when it passes the same title, version and eboot.bin checks.

operations.text:
Bloodborne bbport Windows {version} portable test package with your CUSA00900 game and 1.09 update.
Extract the entire ZIP to a writable folder. Windows 10/11 x64 needs a Vulkan 1.3 driver; run Launch.cmd (or Launch.cmd --play).
Saves, settings, mods and generated files stay in data/. Move the complete folder together.
Official upstream: https://github.com/{repository}
Experimental: not launched on Windows.

windows.instructions: Extract the whole ZIP to a writable folder and run Launch.cmd, or Launch.cmd --play to skip the launcher.

saves: Launch.cmd points APPDATA and BB_* directories at data\ inside the package.
limitations: Experimental. Gameplay has not been confirmed on any platform.
No separate DLC entitlement is added.
Each package is about 30 GB and is stored uncompressed.
Not launched on native Windows. Wine/Proton results would not establish native Windows compatibility.

verified_releases.evidence: Manual 2026-10-11 package assembled and CRC-checked; not launched (RomM 12972).

history: 2026-10-11: assembled by hand with outputs/package-bloodborne.py. This definition automates the same steps.
